mentions.name: miniCron
mentions.description: Windows system scheduler that runs as a service and launches any program at any given time, with cron-like scheduling but no cron syntax. It kills the current task when the service is stopped, reads and logs stdin/stderr, and is very lightweight and simple.
mentions.problem: Existing alternatives such as NSSM (the Non-Sucking Service Manager) and Splinterware exist, but this scheduler is simpler and very light on resources.
mentions.source_excerpt:
- miniCron: system scheduler as a service

Alternatives: NSSM - the Non-Sucking Service Manager; Splinterware

Features: launches any program at any given time (cron like but without cron syntax); kills the current task when the service is stopped; reads and logs stdin/stderr; very light on ressources and very simple
